documents:
CREATE TABLE `documents` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `class_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `created_by` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `format` enum('pdf','docx') COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `version` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `status` enum('queued','processing','ready','needs_ocr','failed') COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `original_bytes` mediumblob NOT NULL,
  `original_digest` binary(32) NOT NULL,
  `size_bytes` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `body` mediumtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin,
  `page_count` smallint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `attempts` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `failure_reason` enum('corrupt','encrypted','unsupported_content','resource_limit','parse_timeout','worker_interrupted','internal_failure') COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_document_version` (`id`,`class_id`,`version`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_document_creator` (`id`,`class_id`,`version`,`created_by`),
  KEY `ix_document_class` (`class_id`,`status`,`id`),
  KEY `ix_document_creator` (`created_by`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_document_class` FOREIGN KEY (`class_id`) REFERENCES `classes` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_document_creator` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_document_attempts` CHECK ((`attempts` <= 3)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_document_original` CHECK (((`size_bytes` between 1 and 10485760) and (length(`original_bytes`) = `size_bytes`))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_document_state` CHECK ((((`status` = _utf8mb4'queued') and (`attempts` <= 2) and (`body` is null) and (`page_count` is null) and (`failure_reason` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'processing') and (`attempts` between 1 and 3) and (`body` is null) and (`page_count` is null) and (`failure_reason` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'ready') and (`attempts` between 1 and 3) and (`body` is not null) and (length(`body`) between 1 and 2097152) and (`failure_reason` is null) and (((`format` = _utf8mb4'pdf') and (`page_count` is not null) and (`page_count` between 1 and 200)) or ((`format` = _utf8mb4'docx') and (`page_count` is null)))) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'needs_ocr') and (`format` = _utf8mb4'pdf') and (`attempts` between 1 and 3) and (`body` is null) and (`page_count` is not null) and (`page_count` between 1 and 200) and (`failure_reason` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'failed') and (`attempts` between 1 and 3) and (`body` is null) and (`page_count` is null) and (`failure_reason` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_document_version` CHECK ((`version` = 1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin
document_locations:
CREATE TABLE `document_locations` (
  `document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `class_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `document_version` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `unit` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `kind` enum('pdf_page','docx_paragraph','docx_table_cell') COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `char_start` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `char_end` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`document_id`,`class_id`,`document_version`,`unit`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_location_document` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`, `class_id`, `document_version`) REFERENCES `documents` (`id`, `class_id`, `version`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_location_range` CHECK (((`char_end` > `char_start`) and (`char_end` <= 2097152))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_location_unit` CHECK (((`unit` between 1 and 20000) and ((`kind` <> _utf8mb4'pdf_page') or (`unit` <= 200))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin
document_chunks:
CREATE TABLE `document_chunks` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `class_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `document_version` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `unit` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `ordinal` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `char_start` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `char_end` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `quote` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_document_chunk` (`document_id`,`class_id`,`document_version`,`unit`,`ordinal`),
  KEY `ix_document_chunk_class` (`class_id`,`document_id`,`document_version`,`unit`,`ordinal`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_chunk_location` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`, `class_id`, `document_version`, `unit`) REFERENCES `document_locations` (`document_id`, `class_id`, `document_version`, `unit`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_document_chunk_ordinal` CHECK ((`ordinal` >= 1)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_document_chunk_range` CHECK (((`char_end` > `char_start`) and (`char_end` <= 2097152) and ((`char_end` - `char_start`) <= 2000) and (char_length(`quote`) = (`char_end` - `char_start`))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin
document_parse_jobs:
CREATE TABLE `document_parse_jobs` (
  `document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `class_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `document_version` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `delivery_state` enum('pending','leased','closed') COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `available_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `worker_owner` char(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `execution_epoch` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `lease_until` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`document_id`),
  KEY `ix_document_job_delivery` (`delivery_state`,`available_at`,`document_id`),
  KEY `ix_document_job_lease` (`delivery_state`,`lease_until`,`document_id`),
  KEY `ix_document_job_source` (`document_id`,`class_id`,`document_version`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_document_job` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`, `class_id`, `document_version`) REFERENCES `documents` (`id`, `class_id`, `version`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_document_job_lease` CHECK ((((`delivery_state` = _utf8mb4'leased') and (`worker_owner` is not null) and (`lease_until` is not null) and (`execution_epoch` >= 1)) or ((`delivery_state` <> _utf8mb4'leased') and (`worker_owner` is null) and (`lease_until` is null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin
document_idempotency:
CREATE TABLE `document_idempotency` (
  `user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `class_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `idempotency_key` varbinary(64) NOT NULL,
  `payload_digest` binary(32) NOT NULL,
  `document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `document_version` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `response_body` mediumblob NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`,`class_id`,`idempotency_key`),
  KEY `ix_document_replay` (`document_id`,`class_id`,`document_version`,`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_document_replay` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`, `class_id`, `document_version`, `user_id`) REFERENCES `documents` (`id`, `class_id`, `version`, `created_by`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_document_replay_body` CHECK (((length(`response_body`) between 1 and 8192) and json_valid(convert(`response_body` using utf8mb4)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_document_replay_key` CHECK ((length(`idempotency_key`) between 16 and 64))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin
